thread:
Riley: Quick heads-up — q4b-int4 bring-up on staging showed a small but consistent regression on the golden set: ~+2% perplexity and a few hallucination fails in RAG holdouts. Can we triage curation/labeling impact?

Priya: ack. can you paste the failing examples and which golden cohorts hit the regressions?

Riley: Pasted a short sample below (from golden/cohort-rare-facts). notable patterns: long-context math/biography prompts and code snippets. A few dupes from seedbank A and B overlapped the holdout.

Riley: ```
1) Q: "When was the first Lisp paper published?" -> model invents 1961 (golden answer: 1958).
2) Q: longcode prompt with mixed markdown + inline SQL -> truncation + hallucinated table columns.
```

Jonas: thanks. initial suspicion: quant kernel reordering + tokenizer boundary effects for long tokens. also if dedupe/overlap caused golden contamination that could inflate failure rate.

Ava: can we run a rapid diff between the golden hash set and the new samplebank snapshot? I can kick that off unless Priya wants the labelers to start relabeling suspicious items.

Priya: please diff first. if overlap >1% we should quarantine those seed ids and rerun a micro-relabel. labelers are on standby but need the small batch.

Matt: I ran overlap check locally — seedbank-A ∩ golden = 0.9%, seedbank-B ∩ golden = 1.3%. combined ~2.1%. attaching quick command I used: 

```bash
python infra/tools/hash_overlap.py --golden gld_v3.jsonl --seedbanks seedA.jsonl seedB.jsonl --out overlap_report.json
```

labeling-bot: scheduled: create_relabel_job(overlap_report.json, priority=high, reviewers=[Priya_team], batch_size=120) :calendar:

Priya: perfect. once labelers finish relabel we should have updated consensus labels in ~8 hours. we should also prepare a tiny canary set that isolates long-context maths/code examples. can someone pick 30-50 examples?

Ava: I'll assemble a 40-example canary from the failing logs and the longctx holdout. Will post link in this thread.

Jonas: parallel action: I'll run a short quant ablation toggling kernel flags (kv-ordering, fp16-accumulate) and tokenization-alignment fallback. expected runtime ~45m. If ablation rescues >60% of the failing canary, likely runtime/quant path bug; otherwise it's curation/labeling.

Riley: timeline sounds good. priorities: 1) quarantine overlaps 2) relabel overlap batch 3) run Jonas ablation 4) test updated model on canary. please ping here when each step completes. thanks :pray:

Priya: relabel job created and assigned. ETA ~7-9h. I'll post interim relabel rate updates.

Matt: saved overlap_report.json to s3://redwood-curation/triage/4823456789/overlap_report.json

Ava: canary uploaded -> s3://redwood-curation/triage/4823456789/canary_v1.jsonl

Jonas: ablation started (run id q4b-ablate-4823456789). I'll post metrics when done.

Riley: awesome. keeping this thread as the single source for next steps. tagging @Priya and @Jonas.

Priya: quick Q — for relabel consensus threshold do we keep 3x labelers + majority or 5x for these rare-fact cohorts?

Ava: for rare-fact/high-ambiguity use 5x. otherwise 3x majority. let's set 5x for the overlap batch.

labeling-bot: update: relabel_job(relab-4823456789) status=IN_PROGRESS assigned=40/40 reviewers alive=12

Riley: thanks everyone. I'll monitor ablation outputs and the golden pass rate once relabel finishes.

(Reaction notes: :eyes: from Jonas, :thumbsup: from Matt)
